name: Early humans
desc: Fire, foraging and stories. Bands live in tents and lean-tos.

name: Stone Age
desc: Knapped flint and ground stone. Huts, farms and the first boats.

name: Bronze Age
desc: Copper and tin become bronze. Rulers, walls, temples and writing.

name: Classical age
desc: Iron, coins, written law and philosophy. Cities with temples, theatres and aqueducts.

name: Age of Sail
desc: Ocean ships, compasses and cannon. The edge of the map is only the beginning.

name: Industrial age
desc: Coal, steam, factories and railways. The towns grow huge, the air turns grey, and the climate starts to change.

name: Electric age
desc: Dynamos, light bulbs, motors and radio. Cities glow at night.

name: Information age
desc: Computers, the internet, clean power and flight. The world shrinks to a screen.

name: Biotech age
desc: Rewritten crops, longer lives, and the power to pull carbon from the sky, or to leave it behind.
